record.dic_text:
04985 mathaq {maw-thak'}

字根型; TWOT - 1268; 動詞

欽定本 - sweet 5; 5

1) 成為甜美或是可喜悅的
   1a) (Qal)
       1a1) 成為甜美的
       1a2) 成為愉悅的
   1b) (Hiphil) 加入甜的味道 (#伯 20:12|)
record.edic_text:
04985 mathaq {maw-thak'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 1268; v

AV - sweet 5; 5

1) to be or become sweet or pleasing
   1a) (Qal)
       1a1) to be or become sweet
       1a2) to be or become pleasant
       1a3) to suck
   1b) (Hiphil) to give sweet taste
